summary: This is the out-of-line copy of Sony's bios.c `callback`, at 0x80081f1c (build/bb2.map:2144) where the deleted glabel alias used to point. The body reads and restores the index via g_cd_reg0 (EXE word 0x1F801800). The control flow is truthful (getintr loop, ready/sync callbacks gated on bits 4/2). No asm, no FAKE needed, no second handle. The s32-typed CD_cbready/CD_cbsync with call-site casts are hygiene debt.
